items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: She was related to my first wife's people. She was a relation you know.

ctx.x: A younger girl, one of the Matthews. She was related to my first wife's people. She was a relation you know. And he had two boys and a girl.
Yes, one of the boys still lives here in New York. And the girl is teaching school in Cincinnati. She's married.
